name: Pathfinder

bonuses.name: Orbital Uplink
bonuses.text: The Pathfinder can broadcast encrypted voice messages and relay its position to any other Threat with the T'AU Keyword within 100 kilometres.

abilities.name: Fire Markerlight
abilities.text: This Threat illuminates an individual within 36m with a Markerlight. Until the start of this Threat's next turn, any Threat with the T'AU Keyword gains +2 bonus dice to ranged attack Tests targeting the individual affected by the Markerlight. The effects of Markerlights do not stack.

abilities.name: Neuroweb System Jammer
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to target an individual or Mob within 20m. The DN of all ranged attack Tests the target makes is increased by +2.

options.name: Four-Strong Pathfinder Team
options.text: A Mob of eight or more Pathfinders can control one Tactical Support Drone, and one Pathfinder can exchange their Pulse Carbine for a Rail Rifle with a tripod.

options.name: Pathfinder Shas'ui
options.text: Sidebar (p.172): Resilience 6 (Recon Armour: 3 AR), Defence 2, Wounds 5, Shock 4, Toughness 3, Willpower 4, Conviction 4, Resolve 3. Other stats as the Pathfinder.

abilities.name: Battlefield Awareness
abilities.text: The Pathfinder Shas'ui's Passive Awareness is doubled (8).

abilities.name: Drone Controller
abilities.text: The Pathfinder Shas'ui can control one Tactical Support Drone.

abilities.name: Lessons of Kauyon
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. All Threats with the T'AU Keyword within 10m of the Pathfinder Shas'ui suffer only half (rounded up) the usual Stealth Score reduction on their next turn.

abilities.name: Experimental Technology
abilities.text: When the Pathfinder Shas'ui rolls a Complication on a Supercharge Attack with their Ion Rifle, the weapon explodes for: 10 +6 ED / AP -2 / Blast (4).

note: Mob option is titled 'Four-Strong Pathfinder Team' but reads 'a Mob of eight or more' (copied as printed). Fire Markerlight is under the ACTION heading.
